**Picture** (screenshot of the preview image or of KiCad)

**What a human would do instead** (for example: "decoupling cap should sit on the back side under the pin",
"switch node loop is too large", "3 A path is only 0.2 mm wide")

**How to reproduce**: generated task `seed=`, `level=`, `cu_layers=`, plus the command line.

This kind of report is very valuable: expert judgement is what the learning loop needs most.
